card.name: Start of G-words and drive/car terms
card.fires_on: Word starts that begin a longer word or abbreviation, mostly a capital G (GFR, GCA, Gout, Graft) or deg-, g-ait, Tr-ig. Also drive/buy near cars in web text.

modes.label: G at start of medical terms
modes.description: A lone G or g that begins an abbreviation or word such as GFR, GCA, gait, Gout, Graft.
modes.example: estimate the glomerular filtration rate (<<G>>FR) through laboratory testing.

modes.label: Partial word starts
modes.description: The first piece of a longer medical word, such as deg- in degenerative or Tr-ig- in Trigeminal.
modes.example: bone disorders and<< deg>>enerative changes in the vital organs.

modes.label: Car buying and driving
modes.description: Verbs or articles about driving or buying cars in opinion web text.
modes.example: over those who continue to<< drive>> gas guzzlers.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it mildly favors RAM/Ram-type tokens and disfavors extract-type tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter or piece of a word, often G in GFR or gout, and sometimes on driving or car-buying words.
